ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark-grey) to high-intensity (white) pixel values.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white pixel clusters are concentrated at the distal tips and along segments of the trailing edges; the central and proximal regions are dominated by low-intensity dark pixels with sparse white mottling and linear streaks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated acute angle of approximately 35-40 degrees and a vertical depth ratio of ~0.20 relative to the fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular, high-frequency serrated boundary; peaks and valleys are most pronounced on the outer thirds of both lobes, featuring jagged pixel-level variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a broad convex curve tapering to sharp points at the tips; the inner leading edges near the notch show a slight concave-to-straight trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast circular white pixel formations located at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, suggesting three-dimensional surface texture.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark-on-white and light-on-dark linear pixel disruptions; a series of 4-5 roughly parallel diagonal rake marks are visible across the left lobe medial surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks across the ventral surface and significant irregular edge-fraying/scars at the distal tips.
